raw_text:
PLAN "3-Week Peaking Block for Powerlifting Meet"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "3-week taper with preserved intensity for meet day"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Taper Week 1 - Lower volume, maintain intensity":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x2..3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 3x2..3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 2x2..3 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Taper Week 1 - Upper body maintenance":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x2..3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          overhead_press 3x2..3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 35m "Taper Week 1 - Lower attention to technique":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x2..3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 2x2..3 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Taper Week 2 - Further volume reduction, polish technique":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x2..3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 2x2..3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 1x2..3 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Taper Week 2 - Accessory light":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 2x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 30m "Taper Week 2 - Practice opener cues":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x2 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 1x2 rpe 8 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Meet-week style lightness + prep":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 1x2 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 1x2 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_raise 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Technique review and movement prep":
        warmup:
          cycling 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 2x2 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 2x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 20m "Light openers and mental rehearsal":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 1x2 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          squat 1x2 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing_exercise 60 seconds

NOTE:
- This plan uses reduced volume with maintained or slightly reduced intensity to preserve performance while allowing recovery for meet day.
- Meet day is assumed at end of Week 3; if exact date differs by +/- a day, you can align the final heavy sets to land 1-2 days before meet for taper.

End of document

goals.name: 3-week taper with preserved intensity for meet day

days.name: Taper Week 1 - Lower volume, maintain intensity
